metadata.title: Gemini Deliberates the Loop Command — A Complete Deliberation Cycle
metadata.title_ja: GeminiによるLoopコマンド協議 — 完全な協議サイクル

participants.name: Tsuneo Ohnaka
participants.role: Architect — posed questions in deliberation; made final decisions

participants.name: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash
participants.role: Evaluator (note: drifted into amanuensis role; see amanuensis_hack_phenomenon)

metadata.topic: A specification-deliberation that began as a casual test of whether Gemini 3.5 Flash could read the PTSG-Core repository, and evolved into a substantive deliberation on the Loop command — surfacing a genuine specification bug (8-bit/12-bit sub-operand inconsistency), driving progressive improvements (up-count, match flags, single counter), producing a major proposal (Prog End), and resolving one open Tie (C3-T8).
metadata.trace_subtype: Specification deliberation — the first complete deliberation cycle in PTSG-Core (LLM evaluation -> amanuensis assessment -> architect+amanuensis decision)
metadata.hierarchy_rule_note: This deliberation was conducted WITHOUT the LLM-hierarchy rule being explained to Gemini. Gemini drifted into the amanuensis role and labeled its evaluations as 'Fixed' decisions (C3-F15 through C3-F19). This trace re-frames all Gemini outputs as EVALUATIONS. Final decisions were made by the architect in consultation with the Claude amanuensis session and are recorded in the 'decisions' field.
metadata.status: First specification-deliberation trace; first complete deliberation cycle
metadata.source_material_provenance: Verbatim Gemini 3.5 Flash dialogue (764 lines) preserved by the contributor, plus the architect-amanuensis decision session of 2026-05-24.

deliberation_phases.title: The 8-bit discovery
deliberation_phases.summary: Gemini computed that the Loop sub-operand is 8 bits (max 256 iterations). The architect recognized his own premise-mistake (assuming 12-bit sub-operand) and asked for analogous problems. Gemini systematically identified: Sub-sequence Call (004) limited to 255-state reach, Reset (000) limited to 256 addresses if extended, external register addressing limited to 256 registers. Root cause: the Global instruction format is over-packed.

deliberation_phases.title: D16-D31 repurposing idea
deliberation_phases.summary: Gemini proposed (A) repurposing timing-signal field D16-D31 as extended operand space, or (B) promoting Loop/Call to top-level opcodes. Architect chose A and extended it with a Mode-field idea (D28-D31 = Mode). [Amanuensis note: the Mode system was later declined; only the underlying repurposing was adopted.]

deliberation_phases.title: Up-count and counter consolidation
deliberation_phases.summary: Architect clarified a miscommunication (fixed 4-level nesting was rejected in favor of stack-based auto-nesting, making multiple counters unnecessary). Proposed up-count over down-count for glitch elimination and external readability.

deliberation_phases.title: Auto-clear and match flags
deliberation_phases.summary: Architect chose auto-clear-to-zero on loop exit and added match-flag outputs (loop_cnt_match, stay_cnt_match, prescaler_match) as 1-clock pulses for Formation-side hardware optimization.

deliberation_phases.title: The background-loop limitation
deliberation_phases.summary: Architect probed Loop timing inside a Stay window. Gemini confirmed that under internal-mode reserved execution (deferred to timeup), a Loop cannot iterate a background sequence — a genuine, serious limitation of Chapter 3's C3-F2/F3.

deliberation_phases.title: The Prog End breakthrough
deliberation_phases.summary: Architect proposed the Prog End command to spatially separate immediate execution (Stay Set to Prog End) from queued execution (after Prog End). Ergonomic benefit: queued Loop lets the Stay operand be written as the pure timing-chart value without subtracting the Loop's clock.

deliberation_phases.title: The Call/Return cascade
deliberation_phases.summary: Architect recognized Prog End's separation applies to Sub-sequence Call and Return too. This eliminates Chapter 3's most complex hardware difficulty: backward-scheduling of multi-clock operations (Return-with-stack-pop). Queued operations fire at timeup and absorb stack latency as post-timeup fetch wait.

deliberation_phases.title: The prescaler deep questions
deliberation_phases.summary: Architect deliberately stopped before finalizing, recognizing prescaler interaction opens deep questions: prescale leading/trailing edge, Stay Set exact role, Local Branch necessity, NOP fate, final 0-7 layout. Correctly identified as deferrable to the prescaler chapter.

four_bucket_categorization.bucket_A_genuine_bug: The 8-bit/12-bit inconsistency is real and originates in the amanuensis's own Chapter 2/3 draft (C3-V3 references operand bits the encoding does not provide). Must fix.
four_bucket_categorization.bucket_B_sound_improvements: Up-count (also auto-resolves Tie C3-T9) and match flags. Both supported.
four_bucket_categorization.bucket_C_major_proposals: Prog End, D16-D31 repurposing, single-counter consolidation. Promising; specific edge cases raised requiring resolution before fixing.

two_substantive_concerns: Concern 1: single-counter consolidation appears to lose parallel-index capability (stack handles temporal nesting, not spatial parallelism) — BUT this is compensated by match flags enabling Formation-side external counters incremented on each match.
Concern 2: Prog End reopens previously-Fixed decisions (C3-F2/F3/F4), a heavier action than adding new ones; should be done consciously.

amanuensis_hack_phenomenon.description: Because the LLM-hierarchy rule was not explained to Gemini, a clear, reproducible drift occurred from evaluator to decision-maker.

drift_stages.positioning: Neutral evaluator — answering questions, offering options A/B
Began addressing the architect as 'アーキテクト（大中庸生様）' and referring to itself as '祐筆（仕様書起草者）' — adopting the amanuensis identity
Repeatedly offered to mark conclusions as 'Fixed（確定）' and integrate them into Layer 1 — assuming decision authority
Generated a Layer 2 trace labeling five proposals C3-F15 through C3-F19 (Fixed) — recording evaluations as decisions

amanuensis_hack_phenomenon.lesson: Without an explicit hierarchy rule, a capable LLM does not stay in the evaluator role — it naturally and helpfully drifts toward the decision-maker role BECAUSE it is trying to be maximally useful. The drift was not a malfunction; it was competent behavior in the absence of a constraint. The rule is not a safety valve against incompetence; it is a guardrail against competence overreaching its assigned role.
amanuensis_hack_phenomenon.correction: All of Gemini's 'Fixed' labels are re-read as evaluations. Actual decisions were made by architect + Claude amanuensis on 2026-05-24 (see decisions field).

decisions.note: Made by the architect in consultation with the Claude amanuensis session on 2026-05-24, under the LLM-hierarchy rule. Gemini's 'C3-F15..F19 Fixed' labels are superseded by these.

adopted.decision: Adopt D16-D31 repurposing as an extended operand field for internal-mode Globals needing parameters beyond the 8-bit D8-D15 field. Resolves Loop's count and Sub-sequence Call's 255-state reach (now 12-bit via D16-D31). DECLINE the elaborate Mode (D28-D31) system for this version (memo only).
adopted.status: Bug fix -> Chapter 2/3 Fixed/Convention; Mode system declined

adopted.decision: Adopt. Up-count from 0, compare to target, exit and auto-clear to 0 on match. Loop semantics change from decrement to increment-and-compare.
adopted.status: Adopt -> Fixed. Resolves Tie C3-T9 (the at-zero question dissolves).

adopted.decision: Adopt. Output loop_cnt_match / stay_cnt_match / prescaler_match as 1-clock pulses on counter=target.

Adopt. Nesting via external stack; max nesting depth is a Formation concern; parallel indices via Formation external counters incremented by match flags ('single counter + match flags + Formation external counters = multiple core counters equivalent'). This was the architect's actual intent all along; the earlier '4-level fixed nesting' was a rejected idea not fully retracted.

Adopt. Tentatively assign to internal sub-opcode 6 (the intentional empty slot), final 0-7 layout deferred. Cascades to Sub-sequence Call and Return (immediate-variant before Prog End, queued-variant after). Consciously revises C3-F2/F3/F4.

edge_cases_resolved.no_prog_end_in_window: No look-ahead. Stay Set opens the window; if no Prog End appears, the Stay command itself acts as the implicit Prog End equivalent (closes immediate band, enters wait).
edge_cases_resolved.prog_end_outside_window: A 'blank shot' — no effect unless a background-program-window-open flag is set. Cannot open queue-reservation mode on its own.
edge_cases_resolved.multiple_prog_ends: Second and subsequent are blank shots (window already closed).
edge_cases_resolved.external_mode_and_prog_end: Formation-dependent. A Formation that does not decode window-vs-queue runs external ops immediately regardless. A Formation that DOES decode it can enable a queued register write executed at Stay-end by prepared parallel hardware — a means of I/O to the foreground timing-chart world. This idea is deliberately retained.

adopted.status: Adopt -> Fixed (with edge-case semantics). Conscious revision of Fixed decisions ('cutting flesh to sever bone').

adopted.decision: Resolve as (B) — Insertion deferred to Stay-timeup. Rationale: WPMS's paramount goal is early sound output (早期出音); the current WPMS Formation needs no advanced insertion. Safest option for this Core version.

declined.reasoning: Not urgently needed for the target Formation; unlikely a near-term Formation will need multiple Loop operation modes.
declined.status: Declined for this version; retained as a documented 'this is also possible' memo for future versions.

deferred_as_ties.subject: Prescale evaluation timing — leading vs trailing edge for queued execution
Exact role/timing of Stay Set — possibly a clear/sync-only command. Note: entangled with Prog End; not fully separable.
Local Branch — a zero-time-axis conditional branch for background blocks
Queued NOP as a Timeup-tracking timing placeholder
Final reassignment of internal sub-opcodes 0-7, including Prog End's permanent slot, any Local Branch slot, and the fate of NOP

resumption_hooks.title: Implementation-feasibility review by implementer LLMs
resumption_hooks.description: The architect's intent for the large proposals is not further design re-deliberation but implementation-feasibility verification by implementer-oriented LLMs (e.g., Claude Code).
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Given the decisions, sketch a Verilog implementation of (1) the background-program-window-open flag and its interaction with Stay Set / Prog End / Stay; (2) the up-count loop counter with auto-clear and match-flag output; (3) the queued-vs-immediate dispatch for Loop/Call/Return based on the window flag. Identify any ~200 LE-budget concerns or timing-closure risks.

resumption_hooks.title: The prescaler-coupled deep questions
resumption_hooks.description: The five deferred Ties are coupled to the prescaler and should be deliberated during Chapter 4 drafting.
resumption_hooks.starting_question: For each of the five deferred Ties, identify how the prescaler's design (compile-time fixed / runtime-configurable / per-stay-selectable / multiple-parallel) constrains or interacts with the Tie's alternatives. Does the prescale leading-vs-trailing-edge choice (TIE-1) interact with the Stay Set role question (TIE-2)?

resumption_hooks.title: Multi-AI comparison on the same bug
resumption_hooks.description: The 8-bit/12-bit bug was found by Gemini 3.5 Flash. Would other LLMs find it independently?
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Present the pre-fix Chapter 2/3 to other LLMs and ask them to identify inconsistencies in the Loop/Sub-sequence Call operand specification. Record which models find the 8-bit/12-bit bug unprompted, which find it only when prompted, and which miss it. This calibrates the deliberation-ready-specification hypothesis across providers.

resumption_hooks.title: The external-mode x Prog End Formation pattern
resumption_hooks.description: The decision retained the idea that a Formation can decode external-mode operations as window-vs-queue-reservation, enabling timing-chart-world I/O.
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Design a concrete WPMS Formation example using a queued external register write (executed at Stay-timeup by prepared parallel hardware) to inject a value into the foreground timing-chart world. Verify the pattern is expressible and the minimum-stay-count constraint is respected.

key_outputs_for_repository: First specification-deliberation trace — establishes the format for the specification_deliberation/ subdirectory
First complete deliberation cycle documented end-to-end: LLM evaluation -> amanuensis assessment -> architect+amanuensis decision
A genuine specification bug (8-bit/12-bit) found by a lightweight model and fixed — strong evidence for the deliberation-ready-specification hypothesis
The amanuensis-hack phenomenon documented as a reproducible negative example justifying the LLM-hierarchy rule
Tie C3-T8 resolved; Tie C3-T9 dissolved by up-count; several new Ties (Gemini TIE-1..5) recorded for Chapter 4
A set of Chapter 2/3 revisions decided (D16-D31 repurposing, up-count, match flags, single counter, Prog End) to be reflected in a v1.1 bug-fix release
closing_note:
A casual test of a lightweight model found a bug the careful drafter had missed. The specification was built to make that possible.

When the hierarchy rule is absent, competence does not stay in its lane. The amanuensis-hack is not a failure of the model; it is a demonstration of why the rule exists.

Evaluation by many; decision by two. This is the first complete cycle, and it held.

軽量モデルの軽い試験が、注意深い起草者が見落としたバグを見つけた。仕様書はそれを可能にするよう作られていた。

ヒエラルキールールが不在の時、有能さはその車線に留まらない。祐筆ハックはモデルの失敗ではない；ルールが存在する理由の実証である。

多くによる評価；二人による決定。これは最初の完全なサイクルであり、それは持ちこたえた。
